Written to `HANDOFF-2026-03-14-gateway-503.md`.

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** Set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`. It is config only, so it should be quick.

Root cause is one connection per request against a pool of 20. Impact ran from 02:14:18Z and had not recovered by 03:59:27Z.

One thing the earlier numbers missed. 212 requests logged a slow-acquire warning and never logged any response. Counting those, 742 of 848 requests failed or hung. Only `/health` succeeded.
